about_the_game:
Paper Bride 4 Bound Love is the 4th work of the Paper Bride series. This Setting Collections include the setting materials and original promotional paintings of Paper 4, the early concept art and the final product. Come on, open this setting collections ,we will take you into a more complete world of Paper Bride.
It mainly includes character setting and design details, scene original painting sketches, promotional pictures, as well as Steam version special promotional original paintings, rare setting materials that have not been made public, etc.

Art setting collection includes the following:
art setting
unpublished character, scene sketch design

Original painting
Public and some unpublished 4K original posters

Love as pure as moonlight
We must endure
For only time will tell.
Thank you for your continued support of the Paper Bride series!
